name: Kaioken Impact
summary: Predicts which files are affected by a described code change by combining an LLM call that extracts candidate symbol/file names with a heuristic graph-based sweep across the repository. The sweep resolves imports, scores text matches (filtering out generic names), and walks dependent modules to build a report of affected modules, documents, and skills. Rendering converts the report to markdown-ish strings. Includes safety limits (file size, file count, concurrency) and a test suite using sample repos.
keyPoints: predictImpact orchestrates: LLM extraction of candidate names → repository sweep for dependents → module/document/skill impact aggregation.
The sweep builds a TextMatcher per candidate name, filters generic names (GENERIC_NAMES set), and uses strong-match heuristics on code-only content to find mentions.
Import resolution handles TS/JS relative imports and Python module specs (tryPythonCandidates, resolvePythonModule, normalizePosix).
Concurrency is capped via SWEEP_CONCURRENCY (24) and file scanning limited to MAX_FILES_SWEPT (8000) and MAX_FILE_BYTES (512 KiB).
Output ImpactReport includes affected modules, documents, and skills; renderImpact converts it to an array of strings (e.g., markdown bullets).
